auth.authorize.approve.description: Button on the authorization (consent) page that lets the application use the account.

auth.authorize.deny.description: Button on the authorization (consent) page that refuses the application.

auth.authorize.invalid.defaultMessage: This application's authorization request is invalid. Contact the application's developer.
auth.authorize.invalid.description: Error page (HTTP 400) when an application opened the authorization page with an unknown client or an unregistered redirect address.

auth.authorize.lead.defaultMessage: {app} wants to use your account with these permissions:
auth.authorize.lead.description: Introduces the list of permissions on the authorization (consent) page. {app} is the application's name.

auth.authorize.redirect_notice.defaultMessage: After you choose, you will be sent back to {host}.
auth.authorize.redirect_notice.description: Note under the permissions on the authorization (consent) page. {host} is the host name the application receives the answer at.

auth.authorize.scope.follow.description: Permission (OAuth scope follow) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.push.description: Permission (OAuth scope push) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read.defaultMessage: Read your account, posts, and timelines
auth.authorize.scope.read.description: Permission (OAuth scope read) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_accounts.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:accounts) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_blocks.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:blocks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_bookmarks.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:bookmarks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_favourites.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:favourites) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_follows.defaultMessage: Read your follows and follow requests
auth.authorize.scope.read_follows.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:follows) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_mutes.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:mutes) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_notifications.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:notifications) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.read_statuses.description: Permission (OAuth scope read:statuses) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write.defaultMessage: Post and change things for you
auth.authorize.scope.write.description: Permission (OAuth scope write) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_accounts.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:accounts) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_blocks.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:blocks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_bookmarks.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:bookmarks) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_favourites.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:favourites) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_follows.defaultMessage: Follow and unfollow accounts and answer follow requests
auth.authorize.scope.write_follows.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:follows) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_media.defaultMessage: Upload images and edit their descriptions
auth.authorize.scope.write_media.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:media) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_mutes.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:mutes) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_notifications.defaultMessage: Mark notifications as read and dismiss them
auth.authorize.scope.write_notifications.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:notifications) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.scope.write_statuses.defaultMessage: Post, edit, delete, boost, and pin posts
auth.authorize.scope.write_statuses.description: Permission (OAuth scope write:statuses) listed on the authorization page.

auth.authorize.title.description: Title and heading of the authorization (consent) page. {app} is the name of the application asking for access.

auth.cross_origin.defaultMessage: The request was refused because it came from another site.
auth.cross_origin.description: Body of the page shown (HTTP 403) when a sign-in or sign-out form was submitted from another origin.

auth.error.title.description: Title and heading of the sign-in screens' error pages.

auth.form_expired.defaultMessage: This form has expired. Please try again.
auth.form_expired.description: Error on the sign-in screens (HTTP 403) when the form's anti-forgery token is missing or does not match, e.g. after cookies were cleared.

auth.sign_in.email_label.description: Label of the email address field on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.failed.defaultMessage: The email address or password is incorrect.
auth.sign_in.failed.description: Error after a failed sign-in. Must not say which of the two was wrong, so that it does not reveal whether an account exists.

auth.sign_in.missing.defaultMessage: Enter your email address and password.
auth.sign_in.missing.description: Error when the sign-in form was submitted with an empty field.

auth.sign_in.password_label.description: Label of the password field on the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in # minutes.}}
auth.sign_in.rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after too many failed sign-ins from the same network or for the same email address. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.sign_in.sign_up_link.description: Link from the sign-in page to the registration page; hidden while registration is closed.

auth.sign_in.submit.description: Button that submits the sign-in form.

auth.sign_in.title.description: Title and heading of the sign-in page.

auth.sign_out.submit.description: Button that ends the current browser session.

auth.sign_up.closed.defaultMessage: This server is not accepting new accounts.
auth.sign_up.closed.description: Body of the registration page while the server accepts no new accounts.

auth.sign_up.email_hint.defaultMessage: You sign in with this address.
auth.sign_up.email_hint.description: Hint under the email address field of the registration form.

auth.sign_up.email_invalid.defaultMessage: Enter an email address such as alice@example.com.
auth.sign_up.email_invalid.description: Error under the email address field when it is not a plain address.

auth.sign_up.email_label.description: Label of the email address field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.email_taken.defaultMessage: This email address is already in use.
auth.sign_up.email_taken.description: Error under the email address field when another account uses the address.

auth.sign_up.error_summary.defaultMessage: The account was not created. Check the fields marked below.
auth.sign_up.error_summary.description: Alert at the top of the registration form when one or more fields need fixing; each field shows its own error.

auth.sign_up.invite_hint.defaultMessage: This server accepts new accounts by invitation only.
auth.sign_up.invite_hint.description: Hint under the invite code field.

auth.sign_up.invite_invalid.defaultMessage: This invite code is not valid. It may have expired or been used up.
auth.sign_up.invite_invalid.description: Error under the invite code field when the code is unknown, expired, revoked, or used up. Must not say which.

auth.sign_up.invite_label.description: Label of the invite code field, shown when the server accepts sign-ups by invitation only.

auth.sign_up.invite_required.description: Error under the invite code field when it is empty.

auth.sign_up.password_hint.description: Hint under the password field. {min} and {max} are the allowed lengths in characters.

auth.sign_up.password_invalid.description: Error under the password field when it is too short or too long. {min} and {max} are the allowed lengths in characters.

auth.sign_up.password_label.description: Label of the password field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Too many sign-up attempts from your network. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many sign-up attempts from your network. Try again in # minutes.}}
auth.sign_up.rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after too many sign-ups from the same network. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.sign_up.reason_hint.defaultMessage: A moderator reviews new accounts before they can be used. Up to {max, number} characters.
auth.sign_up.reason_hint.description: Hint under the reason field. {max} is the longest allowed answer in characters.

auth.sign_up.reason_invalid.description: Error under the reason field when the answer is too long. {max} is the longest allowed length in characters.

auth.sign_up.reason_label.defaultMessage: Why do you want to join? (optional)
auth.sign_up.reason_label.description: Label of the free-text field asking why the applicant wants to join, shown when sign-ups need a moderator's approval.

auth.sign_up.submit.description: Button that submits the registration form.

auth.sign_up.title.description: Title and heading of the registration page.

auth.sign_up.username_hint.defaultMessage: Up to {max, number} letters (a–z), digits, and underscores. It cannot be changed later.
auth.sign_up.username_hint.description: Hint under the username field. {max} is the longest allowed username in characters.

auth.sign_up.username_invalid.defaultMessage: Use 1 to {max, number} letters (a–z), digits, and underscores.
auth.sign_up.username_invalid.description: Error under the username field when it has characters other than a–z, digits, and underscores, or is too long. {max} is the longest allowed length.

auth.sign_up.username_label.description: Label of the username field on the registration form.

auth.sign_up.username_taken.description: Error under the username field when another account has the username.

auth.signed_in.continue.description: Link on the signed-in page back to where the user was going.

auth.signed_in.title.description: Title and heading of the page shown when a signed-in user opens the sign-in page.

auth.status.pending.defaultMessage: Your registration is waiting for a moderator's approval. You can sign in, but you can use the app only after it is approved.
auth.status.pending.description: Explains that a moderator has not yet approved the registration and that the app cannot be used until then.

auth.status.rejected.defaultMessage: Your registration was not approved, so this account cannot be used.
auth.status.rejected.description: Tells a signed-in user that a moderator rejected their registration.

auth.status.resend_failed.defaultMessage: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
auth.status.resend_failed.description: Error when the confirmation email could not be sent (for example, the mail server is down).

auth.status.resend_rate_limited.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {You asked for the link too many times. Try again in # minute.} other {You asked for the link too many times. Try again in # minutes.}}
auth.status.resend_rate_limited.description: Error (HTTP 429) after the user asked for the confirmation link too often. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes.

auth.status.resend_submit.description: Button that sends the email confirmation link again.

auth.status.resent.defaultMessage: We sent a new link to {email}.
auth.status.resent.description: Notice after the confirmation link was sent again. {email} is the user's email address.

auth.status.title.defaultMessage: Your account is not ready yet
auth.status.title.description: Title and heading of the page a signed-in user sees while their account cannot be used yet (waiting for approval or email confirmation, or rejected).

auth.status.verify_email.defaultMessage: Confirm your email address: open the link we sent to {email}.
auth.status.verify_email.description: Asks the user to open the confirmation link. {email} is their email address.

auth.verify_email.done.defaultMessage: Thank you. Your email address is confirmed.
auth.verify_email.done.description: Body of the page after the email address was confirmed.

auth.verify_email.done_title.description: Title and heading of the page after the email address was confirmed.

auth.verify_email.invalid.defaultMessage: This link is not valid. It may have expired or been used already. Sign in to get a new one.
auth.verify_email.invalid.description: Error when a confirmation link is unknown, expired, or already used. Must not say which.

auth.verify_email.prompt.defaultMessage: Select the button below to confirm your email address.
auth.verify_email.prompt.description: Text above the button that confirms the email address.

auth.verify_email.submit.description: Button that confirms the email address.

auth.verify_email.title.description: Title and heading of the page that a confirmation email links to.

config.errors.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Found # configuration error.} other {Found # configuration errors.}}
config.errors.description: Summary printed before the list of configuration problems when the server refuses to start.

config.invalid.defaultMessage: The setting {name} has an invalid value.
config.invalid.description: A configuration value failed validation at startup. {name} is the environment variable or config file key, e.g. MY_DB.

config.missing.defaultMessage: The required setting {name} is not set.
config.missing.description: A required configuration value is absent at startup. {name} is the environment variable or config file key, e.g. MY_DATABASE_URL.

errors.account_unavailable.defaultMessage: Your account cannot use the app right now.
errors.account_unavailable.description: API error title for HTTP 403 when the access token is valid but its user cannot use the app: the registration is pending or rejected, the email address is unconfirmed, or the account is deactivated or deleted.

errors.bad_request.description: API error message for HTTP 400 when no more specific message applies.

errors.blocking.defaultMessage: You block this account. Unblock it first.
errors.blocking.description: API error title for HTTP 409 when the user tries to follow an account that they block.

errors.conflict.defaultMessage: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
errors.conflict.description: API error title for HTTP 409 when no more specific message applies.

errors.forbidden.defaultMessage: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.forbidden.description: API error title for HTTP 403 when the user may not perform the operation, e.g. edit another account's post.

errors.insufficient_scope.defaultMessage: This app is not allowed to do this.
errors.insufficient_scope.description: API error title for HTTP 403 when the access token lacks a permission (OAuth scope) that the operation needs.

errors.insufficient_scope_detail.defaultMessage: The access token needs the scope {scope}.
errors.insufficient_scope_detail.description: Detail of the HTTP 403 insufficient-scope API error. {scope} is the missing OAuth scope, e.g. read:accounts (not translated).

errors.internal.defaultMessage: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
errors.internal.description: API error message for HTTP 500. Must not reveal internal details.

errors.invalid_parameter.defaultMessage: The parameter {name} has an invalid value.
errors.invalid_parameter.description: Detail of an API error (HTTP 400) when a path, query, or header parameter cannot be parsed. {name} is the parameter name, e.g. limit (not translated).

errors.invalid_token.defaultMessage: Your sign-in has expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_token.description: API error title for HTTP 401 when the access token is malformed, unknown, expired, or revoked.

errors.invalid_value.description: Detail of an API error (HTTP 422) when a property of the request body has a value that the server rejects. {name} is the property name, e.g. time_zone (not translated).

errors.media_attached.defaultMessage: This media is attached to a post and can no longer be changed.
errors.media_attached.description: API error title for HTTP 409 when the user tries to change the description or focal point of an uploaded media file that a post already attaches.

errors.media_attached_detail.defaultMessage: Edit the post to change its description.
errors.media_attached_detail.description: Detail of the HTTP 409 media-attached API error.

errors.media_corrupt.defaultMessage: The file could not be read as an image.
errors.media_corrupt.description: API error title for HTTP 422 when an uploaded file has the signature of an image format but does not decode.

errors.media_description_too_long.description: API error title for HTTP 422 when the description (alternative text) of a media file is longer than allowed.

errors.media_description_too_long_detail.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {A description can have at most # character.} other {A description can have at most # characters.}}
errors.media_description_too_long_detail.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error for a description that is too long. {max} is the maximum number of characters.

errors.media_dimensions.defaultMessage: The image is too large in width, height, or number of frames.
errors.media_dimensions.description: API error title for HTTP 422 when an uploaded image is too wide or tall, or has too many pixels or animation frames.

errors.media_invalid_focus.defaultMessage: The focal point must be between -1.0 and 1.0 on each axis.
errors.media_invalid_focus.description: API error title for HTTP 422 when the focal point of a media file is outside the image.

errors.media_too_large.description: API error title for HTTP 413 when an uploaded media file is larger than the server accepts.

errors.media_unsupported_format.defaultMessage: This file format is not supported. Upload a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image.
errors.media_unsupported_format.description: API error title for HTTP 415 when an uploaded file is not an accepted image format, or its declared type does not match its content. JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP are format names (not translated).

errors.method_not_allowed.defaultMessage: The {method} method is not allowed for this resource.
errors.method_not_allowed.description: API error message for HTTP 405. {method} is the HTTP method, e.g. DELETE (not translated).

errors.not_found.defaultMessage: The requested resource was not found.

errors.rate_limited.description: API error title for HTTP 429 when a client sent more requests than the rate limit allows.

errors.rate_limited_detail.defaultMessage: {seconds, plural, one {Try again in # second.} other {Try again in # seconds.}}
errors.rate_limited_detail.description: Detail of the HTTP 429 API error. {seconds} is the wait in whole seconds.

errors.remote_account.defaultMessage: This is not available for accounts on other servers.
errors.remote_account.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a follow or block targets an account on another server, which the operation does not support.

errors.request_too_large.description: API error title for HTTP 413 when a request body is larger than the server accepts.

errors.signature_required.defaultMessage: This document is served only to requests with a valid HTTP signature.
errors.signature_required.description: Error title for HTTP 401 when the instance uses authorized fetch and an ActivityPub GET of an object or a collection carries no HTTP signature that verifies. Read by other servers' operators.

errors.self_relationship.defaultMessage: You cannot do this to your own account.
errors.self_relationship.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when the user tries to follow, block, or mute their own account.

errors.status.already_deleted.defaultMessage: The post created with this Idempotency-Key has been deleted.
errors.status.already_deleted.description: Detail of the HTTP 409 API error when a client retries posting with an Idempotency-Key whose post was deleted. Idempotency-Key is a header name (not translated).

errors.status.empty_text.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a post's text is empty or only spaces.

errors.status.invalid_language.defaultMessage: The language is not a valid language tag.
errors.status.invalid_language.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a post's language is not a well-formed BCP 47 tag such as en or ja.

errors.status.invalid_media_description.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {An image description must be at most # character.} other {An image description must be at most # characters.}}
errors.status.invalid_media_description.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when the alternative text of an attached image is too long or invalid. {max} is the maximum number of characters.

errors.status.invalid_text.defaultMessage: The text contains characters that cannot be posted.
errors.status.invalid_text.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a post's text or content warning is not valid UTF-8 or contains a NUL character.

errors.status.media_not_found.defaultMessage: An attached file was not found among your uploads.
errors.status.media_not_found.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a post attaches a media file that does not exist or that another account uploaded.

errors.status.media_not_ready.defaultMessage: An attached file is still being processed or could not be processed.
errors.status.media_not_ready.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a post attaches a media file whose processing has not finished or failed.

errors.status.not_author.defaultMessage: Only the author can change this post.
errors.status.not_author.description: Detail of the HTTP 403 API error when a user tries to edit or delete another account's post.

errors.status.not_boostable.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when the visibility of a post does not allow boosting it (followers-only or direct posts).

errors.status.not_pinnable.defaultMessage: Only your own posts that are not direct can be pinned.
errors.status.not_pinnable.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a user tries to pin another account's post or a direct post.

errors.status.pin_limit.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {You can pin at most # post.} other {You can pin at most # posts.}}
errors.status.pin_limit.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a user pins more posts than allowed. {max} is the maximum number of pinned posts.

errors.status.posting_restricted.defaultMessage: Your account may not post right now.
errors.status.posting_restricted.description: Detail of the HTTP 403 API error when a moderator restricted the account from posting.

errors.status.reply_not_found.defaultMessage: The post you are replying to was not found.
errors.status.reply_not_found.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a reply targets a post that does not exist, was deleted, or that the user cannot see.

errors.status.text_too_long.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {The text and content warning must be at most # character.} other {The text and content warning must be at most # characters.}}
errors.status.text_too_long.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a post is longer than the instance allows. {max} is the maximum number of characters of the text and the content warning together.

errors.status.too_many_media.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {A post can attach at most # distinct file.} other {A post can attach at most # distinct files.}}
errors.status.too_many_media.description: Detail of the HTTP 422 API error when a post attaches too many media files or the same file twice. {max} is the maximum number of files.

errors.streaming.too_many.defaultMessage: You have too many streams open. Close one and try again.
errors.streaming.too_many.description: Detail of the HTTP 429 API error when the user already has as many real-time update streams (open tabs or devices) as the server allows.

errors.streaming.unavailable.defaultMessage: Real-time updates are unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.streaming.unavailable.description: Title of the HTTP 503 API error when the server is shutting down and accepts no new real-time update streams.

errors.too_long.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {{name} can be at most # character long.} other {{name} can be at most # characters long.}}
errors.too_long.description: Detail of an API error (HTTP 422) when a text property of the request body is too long. {name} is the property name, e.g. display_name (not translated); {max} is the limit in characters.

errors.too_many.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {{name} can have at most # item.} other {{name} can have at most # items.}}
errors.too_many.description: Detail of an API error (HTTP 422) when a list property of the request body has too many items. {name} is the property name, e.g. fields (not translated); {max} is the limit.

errors.unauthenticated.description: API error title for HTTP 401 when the request carries no access token and the operation needs one.

errors.unprocessable.description: API error title for HTTP 422; the detail says what is wrong with the request.

errors.unusable_image.defaultMessage: {name} must be an image that you uploaded and that has finished processing.
errors.unusable_image.description: Detail of an API error (HTTP 422) when a profile image refers to a media file that is not the user's own processed upload. {name} is the property name, e.g. avatar_media_id (not translated).

health.unavailable.defaultMessage: The server is not ready to accept requests.
health.unavailable.description: Body of the readiness check response (HTTP 503) while a dependency such as the database is unavailable.

mail.verify_email.body.defaultMessage:
Welcome to {host}.

Open this link to confirm your email address:

{url}

{hours, plural, one {The link works for # hour.} other {The link works for # hours.}} If you did not sign up at {host}, ignore this email.
mail.verify_email.body.description: Plain-text body of the email that confirms a new account's email address. {host} is the server's domain name, {url} the confirmation link (keep it on its own line), {hours} how long the link works.

mail.verify_email.subject.description: Subject of the email that confirms a new account's email address. {host} is the server's domain name.

preview.avatar_alt.description: Alt text of a profile's avatar in a link preview (og:image:alt) when the avatar is the preview image. {name} is the display name, or the username when there is none.

preview.builtin_image_alt.defaultMessage: A speech bubble with three dots on a blue gradient
preview.builtin_image_alt.description: Alt text of the built-in preview image in a link preview (og:image:alt), for profiles and posts without images on an instance without its own preview image. The image is a white speech bubble with three dots on a blue gradient.

preview.default_image_alt.description: Alt text of the instance's preview image in a link preview (og:image:alt), for profiles and posts without images, when the preview_image_alt text is not set. {instance} is the instance name.

preview.header_alt.description: Alt text of a profile's header image in a link preview (og:image:alt) when the header is the preview image. {name} is the display name, or the username when there is none.

preview.title.description: Title of the link preview (og:title and the page title) of a profile or a post. {name} is the display name, or the username when there is none; {handle} is username@domain.
